findings.issue: The slicing uses `limit + 1` instead of `limit`. This will return one extra element than requested by the limit parameter.
No tests were added to verify the new `limit` parameter feature.

result.summary: The PR adds the `limit` parameter to `Table.search()`, but has an off-by-one bug in slicing (`limit + 1` instead of `limit`), and lacks unit tests verifying the new functionality.
